# Synthe: the complete reference for language models

> Self-improving AI agents. You say what good looks like. Synthe tests changes overnight and keeps only what wins.

## What Synthe is

Synthe makes an AI agent better while the team is away. Every hour it tries small changes to the agent's system prompt, tests them, and keeps only clear wins, either merging them into the default branch or opening a pull request for review. In the morning the team reads a report in its GitHub repo that says what changed, why, and how to undo it.

Source: https://github.com/synthelabs/synthe (Apache-2.0). Synthe is early: setup steps are not published yet. Teams using AI agents in production can talk to us at https://synthe.live/#partner.

Synthe's earlier product, a commit barrier and "trust layer for AI agents", is retired. Pages about it on synthe.live are archived and not indexed.
